truth: Canonical main baseline remains 649002eebc6e378026f324df5d04adb3653c8b64 after consumer Friction Memory reachability landed.

The prior UX-01 interaction-depth lineage was preserved from 76b09bfb0a2a551dd8b8ab1551f8158e61269c10 rather than rebuilt or silently discarded; ASK/ADVISE/TRY/DO authority remains separate from DO IT/WITH ME/SHOW ME/EXPLAIN WHY/LET ME TRY collaboration depth.

The artist explicitly redirected the current work toward retention: N0TE must remember, consult and use prior work without creating a second memory database or flattening history into permanent doctrine.

HeadquartersMemory now composes a SongRetentionService over the existing Evidence, Context imports, Sessions, Learning, Success, Friction, Skills and Activity systems. The retention service owns no persistence of its own.
Retention distinguishes immutable/append-only history from active supersedable durable Evidence claims. Superseded claims remain history but are not returned as current durable facts.
Learning and Success remain association-only unless causality is independently proven. One KEEP decision cannot become a causal rule, taste doctrine, permanent preference or automatic action policy.
Friction recurrence remains explicit and requires the same blocker key across at least two distinct work Sessions; same-Session repetition cannot manufacture recurrence.
Imported or synced context remains EVIDENCE_ONLY. Retention may consult it but cannot promote it into action authority or canonical observed fact.
Skill state remains the latest explicit Skill assessment; Session notes and Learning outcomes do not silently mutate SkillMemory.
Retention context packets omit internal Song/Session/Learning/claim/source-reference identities, are JSON-safe, can select bounded sections, perform no writes and grant no action authority.

The normal Song page now exposes a read-only What N0TE remembers card with current thread, next action, active durable facts, recurring blocker summary, skill context and imported-context count while preserving the detailed canonical memory surfaces already present.
Quit/relaunch continuity is regression-tested so the same retained thread and next action reappear from canonical local memory after reopening.
Exact-head observations are runtime evidence and never become current merely because a prior commit was green; each new head must be observed independently.
Known unfinished scope is not selected work. Selection requires current_state plus a bounded active receipt.
Construction may terminate at STABLE, WAITING or BLOCKED with zero ACTIVE graph nodes. STABLE is the destination after justified construction, not an invitation to invent adjacent work.
After this increment lands or blocks, re-evaluate the whole acceptance spine instead of continuing by memory-subsystem adjacency.
